description: Get the details and full transcript of a specific memory/conversation. Long transcripts come in pages: when more remains, the output ends with the offset to pass for the next page.

limit.description: Maximum utterances in this page (default 200, max 500). A page also stops before the response size cap.

memoryId.description: The ID of the memory to retrieve

offset.description: 0-based index of the first utterance to return (default 0). Use the offset given at the end of the previous page.

name: get_memory
